verdicts.note: Rule specifying sentence case for titles of classics in references and in-text citations.
Rule requiring italics for titles of books, series, and anthologies.
Rule requiring quotation marks for titles of chapters, poems, or sections.
Rule requiring any cited classics to be included in the reference list if one is used.
Advice to the writer conditioned on their personal knowledge rather than a testable text rule (G-5).
Rule requiring the edition date instead of the creation date in the reference list.
Rule requiring the date to be placed at the end of the reference list entry.
Rule requiring divisions to be included in in-text citations when the work has them.
Rule requiring a comma between divisions in the initial citation.
Rule requiring a colon between the date and page numbers.
Rule forbidding spaces around the colon separating date and page numbers.
Rule specifying the use of the English title shown on the cited source for translated works.
Rule requiring the title in the original language when quoting text in that language.
Advice to the writer conditioned on external link availability (G-5).
